title: Contract
description:
Catalog of wire types, not an HTTP response. Exported definitions describe
implemented M0 payloads; routing and authentication remain in the API design.

communication_verified.description: Always false: exporting inventory does not perform a communication test.

Decimal.description: Canonical u64 encoded as a decimal string to avoid JavaScript rounding.

DeviceReport.description: A read-only inventory snapshot, never a hardware communication certificate.

kernel_release.description: Kernel release, not the macOS product version. No hostname is collected.

passed.description: Workload/quality criteria only; pass ALSO requires completed execution and complete evidence.

StressCoordination.description: Transport is authenticated out-of-band (same-UID socket or SSH). No clock offset is assumed.

max_payload_errors.description: Sum of CRC and pattern errors per receiver.

min_submitted_ppm.description: Checked for the entire run AND every compiled stage (including warmup).

denominator.description: Present for ratios; limit is in ppm. Integer cross-products decide the result.

sample_every.description: Zero disables frame samples; online verification remains complete.

receivers_active.description: Normal controller participation (ACK), not generation of data frames.

tracking_bytes.description: Estimated retained tracking state; includes optional telemetry reserves. Execution queue reserve is separate.
